I applied the source policy in place to /Users/liammagnier/Developer/project/juno/docs/design/artifacts-design/03-COMPETITIVE-AUDIT.md. It went from 1,720 to 1,680 lines. Section structure, headings, tables, Juno file refs and fact-check tags are unchanged. No other file was edited.

**Checks after the edits:**
- No links to github.com/asgeirtj/system_prompts_leaks remain.
- The only "leak" matches left are Juno defect wording ("leak later edits (M31)", "review leaks writes (M46)").
- No quoted passage is longer than 25 words (a script checked every quote).

**Header**
- The research-notes line now says each lens "is filed at `research/<lens>.md`". Note: only claude-primary-evidence.md, figma-ai-products.md, figma-files-collab.md and others.md were in research/ when I checked. claude-design and claude-ux-motion still exist only in the session scratchpad; another session is presumably filing them.
- The [C] tag is now "Hacker News, vendor forums, personal blogs and app-store reviews". The leaked prompt and the "matches line for line" note are gone.
- Research limits: the values are now "observed in the shipped Claude desktop app". I added one sentence: unofficial copies of vendor system prompts are not used as evidence, and a behaviour known only from them is marked "(not publicly documented)".
- The first-hand tag line describes the app as "styles and interface inspected directly", no longer "CSS, JS and i18n read directly".

**Summary**
- Item 8: the Claude Design bullet (paints from the first streamed character, placeholders, hot-reload with no remount) relied only on the leak. The "liveness" conclusion now rests on:
  - the first-hand Imagine contract: inline visuals diff partial HTML into the live DOM as tokens arrive;
  - the Docs skeleton, the 0.5 s skeleton delay and Figma's shimmer (all already in the doc).
- How Claude Design fills its canvas is marked "(not publicly documented)".
- Item 4 and item 8 now say "observed in the shipped Claude desktop app" in place of "bundle".

**§2.1**
- The card and panel notes are re-attributed to the shipped app.
- The verbatim "Artifact panel: {title}" label is now "a labelled region named after the artifact's title".

**§2.2 Claude Design**
- The file: "streaming" is now "self-contained" (the wording of the first-hand evidence). Removed the "same format as the leak, so the leak is genuine and the standalone engine is re-hosted" inference. Whether standalone shares the format is now "(not publicly documented)".
- The standalone container: the internal layout (tab bar, uploads/, .napkin, CLAUDE.md, github.md Sync) is removed. It is rewritten as a project from a project picker (getpushtoprod [S]) with its own settings, analytics and storage (admin guide [P]). The file layout is "(not publicly documented)".
- Craft rules: removed the "standalone forks a background verifier" line.
- Workflow step 3: removed the leak's question-form mechanics. The Builder.io "taste exam" and PCWorld's multiple-choice questions are kept.
- Workflow step 4: removed "streams into the canvas" (leak-only); it is now "(not publicly documented)".
- Refine table:
  - Inline comments: removed the claim that data-comment-anchor anchors survive regeneration.
  - Direct edit: the `!important` override and `<mentioned-element>` claims are replaced with first-hand evidence: a properties panel edits inline styles, and the view state (artboard and selection) is passed to Claude.
  - Tweaks: "Where and how" now says Claude-made sliders shown as levers in the editor. The leaked floating panel and the leaked "reserve tweaks for…" rule are removed.
  - Draw: added getpushtoprod [S], its non-leak source.
- Options: removed the leaked recipe (1a/1b ids, newest round on top, "Try next", pan and zoom). How options are laid out and referred to is marked not documented.
- Handoff bundle: removed the leaked README contents; Anthropic's public description is kept. What the bundle contains, motion included, is "(not publicly documented)".
- Motion in Claude Design: removed stream-to-canvas painting, the Tweaks panel values, the deck stage values and animated video (animations_v3, timeline, easing library, 300 s export, the "always in motion" rule). A new intro says these are not publicly documented and that video is not in the documented export list. Live tweaks [P], Slides transitions [P·1st] and select-and-move [P] are kept.
- Weaknesses: removed "the model's own prompt admits all your designs feel similar / RNG".

**§2.3**
- The 28-word Felix Rieseberg HN quote is paraphrased, keeping two short quoted phrases.

**§2.4 (shipped app, rule 4)**
- The CDS table keeps all values, but the eight `--cds-*` identifiers became plain role names, and the note uses "snap curve" and "overshoot curve".
- These are paraphrased with their values kept, no longer code or verbatim strings:
  - the user-bubble CSS snippet;
  - the `blur(6px)` excerpt;
  - the `aria-hidden` clone;
  - the four verbatim "Thinking…" strings;
  - the verbatim conflict message;
  - the `:root[data-reduce-motion=true]` selector.
- Hot swap: dropped the `_ldx_*` identifier and the cell-level internals; the "(unverified) on Design pages" caveat is kept.

**§5 matrix**
- Row 5 is now "~3 options by default".
- Row 21 Claude: partial (Docs fill section by section; Design not publicly documented).
- Row 32 Claude: ✗ not publicly documented.
- Row 36 Claude: ✗ not in the documented export list.
- Row 62 Claude: partial, handoff bundle with motion not publicly documented. It was ✓ only because of the leaked README.

**§6**
- U7: re-attributed to the shipped app.
- A4: the evidence is now the first-hand Design view state and the Docs selected blocks, in place of `<mentioned-element>`.
- A7: rewritten to multiple-choice questions with skippable answers, backed by PCWorld and Builder.io [S]. "Decide for me" and "typing cancels" are dropped.
- A8: rewritten to N variants side by side, each nameable in chat, with Shift-select. It is backed by Claude's ~3 options [S], Stitch [P] and Figma's "Create 3 motion variants" [P]. The leaked 1a/1b ids, newest-on-top and "Try next" are dropped.
- E6: the tag is now [P] only.

**§7**
- The §7.1 header is re-attributed, and the `dur-*` identifiers became plain ms values.
- M6: the evidence is now the inline-visual streaming [P·1st], in place of the leaked Design painting.
- M14: the evidence is now "Claude's tweaks change the design live" [P] plus the app's panes and phone drawer switching transitions off while dragged [P·1st], in place of the leaked Tweaks-panel timings. The Juno spec is unchanged.
- §7.4 Present chrome: the "(Claude deck stage [C])" attribution is removed; the Juno spec stays.

**§8 and §9**
- The three "Bundle [P·1st]" cells now read "Observed in the shipped Claude desktop app".
- "`_ldx` hot swap" is now "the desktop app's hot-swap runtime".
- The §9.1 app source line no longer carries the ion-dist, i18n and `_frame-rt` identifiers.
- §9.2: the leaked-prompt source line is removed.

**Not changed, but worth knowing**
- Values from the shipped app (durations, curves, px sizes, 0.5 s delay, 520 px card) stay as short facts.
- The Docs viewer module names (VersionBar, VersionPreviewPane, BottomSheet) stay; they come from claude-primary-evidence.md, not the app bundle.
- The Imagine-contract quotes are all short.
- 00-AUDIT-OVERVIEW.md and 02-AUDIT-MAC.md use "leaked" only for unrelated Juno defects; neither references the leak repo.
- I did not check 04-MERGE-PLAN.md or HANDOFF.md for dependence on the claims removed here. For example, any plan step built on the 1a/1b option ids, the leaked question form, the Tweaks or deck-stage timings, or Claude's motion-bearing handoff bundle would now lack support.
